description: Right-to-left playlist rows (qust-text): Persian with digits, Hebrew with points, Arabic with vowel marks, lam-alef, Urdu, Arabic already in presentation forms, Kurdish, Syriac, Thaana, a long Arabic title (ellipsis), digits inside Arabic. Hebrew station, Persian title.
note: Boxes are [x, y, width, height] in CSS px at scale 1. A value that differs between the themes is { "dark": …, "light": … }. Colors are [r, g, b, a]. Omitted properties have their initial value (see layout/tokens.json "defaults").
